workflow.title: Zero-Downtime Database Migration Workflow
workflow.step: Add new columns as nullable or with safe defaults. Never rename or delete active columns in a single migration.
Update application code to write to both old and new columns while reading primarily from the old column, deployed without downtime.
Run an idempotent background backfill script to populate new columns for historical records. Verify row counts and checksums.
Switch reads to the new column. In a subsequent release, remove deprecated column usage and safely drop the old column.
